---
title: "revision.beta"
author: "BH"
date: "2026-10-13"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# REVISED BETA-DIVERSITY ANALYSIS
#
# HOUSE-AWARE PERMANOVA + BETA DISPERSION
#
# Uses the SAME general PERMANOVA method as the original analysis:
#   vegan::adonis2()
#
# Input:
#   physeq_no_growout3_css
#   physeq_no_growout3
#
# Experimental design:
#
#   House
#     = independent experimental unit
#
#   Treatment
#     = assigned at the House level
#
#   Growout
#     = repeated within House
#
#   Position
#     = defined physical location A-E within House
#     = same locations followed across both Growouts
#
#
# PERMANOVA strategy
# --------------------------------------------------------------
#
# Collective Treatment:
#
#   distance ~ Treatment + Growout + Position
#
#   Whole Houses are permuted.
#   All Growout x Position observations belonging to a House
#   remain together.
#
#
# Collective Growout:
#
#   distance ~ Treatment + Growout + Position
#
#   Entire Growout blocks are permuted within House.
#   The five defined Positions within a Growout stay together.
#
#
# Collective Position:
#
#   distance ~ Treatment + Growout + Position
#
#   Position trajectories are permuted within House.
#
#   Example:
#     Position A = Growout 1 A + Growout 2 A
#
#   Those two observations remain linked and move together when
#   the Position label is permuted.
#
#
# Treatment x Growout:
#
#   distance ~ Treatment * Growout + Position
#
#   Whole Houses are permuted.
#   Therefore Growout and Position observations remain linked
#   to their respective House.
#
#
# Treatment within each Growout:
#
#   distance ~ Treatment + Position
#
#   Whole Houses are permuted.
#
#
# Beta dispersion:
#
#   Treatment:
#     whole-House permutation
#
#   Growout:
#     Growout blocks within House
#
#   Position:
#     Position trajectories within House
#
#   Treatment within Growout:
#     whole-House permutation
#
#
# IMPORTANT:
#
#   - House remains the Treatment-level experimental unit.
#   - Position is an explicit covariate in PERMANOVA.
#   - Position is NOT used as the permutation stratum for Treatment.
#   - Defined Position locations remain linked across Growouts.
#   - No Condition() is used.
#   - No dbRDA is used.
#   - No existing analysis objects are overwritten.
#   - All new objects end in "_houseperm".
# ==============================================================


library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(permute)
library(dplyr)


# ==============================================================
# 1. Settings
# ==============================================================

set.seed(42)

nperm_houseperm <- 9999


# ==============================================================
# 2. Reattach phylogenetic tree to CSS-normalized object
#
# Same input structure used in the original beta-diversity
# analysis, but with a new object name.
# ==============================================================

ps_full_houseperm <- phyloseq::merge_phyloseq(
  physeq_no_growout3_css,
  phyloseq::phy_tree(
    physeq_no_growout3
  )
)


# ==============================================================
# 3. Extract metadata
# ==============================================================

meta_houseperm <- data.frame(
  phyloseq::sample_data(
    ps_full_houseperm
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
)


# ==============================================================
# 4. Confirm required metadata variables
# ==============================================================

required_cols_houseperm <- c(
  "Treatment",
  "House",
  "Growout",
  "Position"
)


missing_cols_houseperm <- setdiff(
  required_cols_houseperm,
  names(
    meta_houseperm
  )
)


if (
  length(
    missing_cols_houseperm
  ) > 0
) {

  stop(
    paste(
      "Missing required metadata columns:",
      paste(
        missing_cols_houseperm,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 5. Set factors
# ==============================================================

meta_houseperm$Treatment <- factor(
  as.character(
    meta_houseperm$Treatment
  ),
  levels = c(
    "Control",
    "IndigoLT"
  )
)


meta_houseperm$House <- factor(
  meta_houseperm$House
)


meta_houseperm$Growout <- factor(
  as.character(
    meta_houseperm$Growout
  ),
  levels = c(
    "1",
    "2"
  )
)


meta_houseperm$Position <- factor(
  as.character(
    meta_houseperm$Position
  ),
  levels = c(
    "A",
    "B",
    "C",
    "D",
    "E"
  )
)


# ==============================================================
# 6. Confirm that Treatment is constant within House
# ==============================================================

house_treatment_map_houseperm <-
  meta_houseperm %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    House,
    Treatment
  )


house_treatment_check_houseperm <-
  house_treatment_map_houseperm %>%
  dplyr::count(
    House,
    name = "n_treatments"
  )


if (
  any(
    house_treatment_check_houseperm$n_treatments != 1
  )
) {

  stop(
    "At least one House has more than one Treatment assignment."
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 7. Confirm balanced House x Growout x Position structure
#
# Expected:
#   6 Houses
#   2 Growouts per House
#   5 defined Positions per House
#   one sample per House x Growout x Position
# ==============================================================

design_table_houseperm <- with(
  meta_houseperm,
  table(
    House,
    Growout,
    Position
  )
)


if (
  any(
    design_table_houseperm != 1
  )
) {

  stop(
    paste(
      "House x Growout x Position is not perfectly balanced.",
      "Inspect design_table_houseperm before continuing."
    )
  )
}


cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "DESIGN CHECK\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  sep = ""
)


cat(
  "Number of Houses:",
  nlevels(
    meta_houseperm$House
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Treatment allocation by House:\n"
)


print(
  table(
    house_treatment_map_houseperm$Treatment
  )
)


cat(
  "\nHouse x Growout x Position structure:\n"
)


print(
  design_table_houseperm
)


# ==============================================================
# 8. Order samples consistently within House
#
# Every House is ordered as:
#
#   Growout 1:
#     A B C D E
#
#   Growout 2:
#     A B C D E
#
# Whole-House and Growout-block permutations preserve this
# internal structure.
#
# Position trajectories are explicitly identified below using
# House x Position, so the same physical Position remains linked
# across both Growouts.
# ==============================================================

sample_order_houseperm <- order(
  meta_houseperm$House,
  meta_houseperm$Growout,
  meta_houseperm$Position
)


meta_houseperm <- meta_houseperm[
  sample_order_houseperm,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


sample_ids_houseperm <- rownames(
  meta_houseperm
)


# ==============================================================
# 9. Create repeated-measures block identifiers
#
# House x Growout:
#   identifies each five-Position Growout block.
#
# House x Position:
#   identifies each defined Position trajectory across Growouts.
#
# Example:
#   House 1 x Position A contains:
#       Growout 1, Position A
#       Growout 2, Position A
# ==============================================================

meta_houseperm$House_Growout_houseperm <- interaction(
  meta_houseperm$House,
  meta_houseperm$Growout,
  drop = TRUE,
  lex.order = TRUE
)


meta_houseperm$House_Position_houseperm <- interaction(
  meta_houseperm$House,
  meta_houseperm$Position,
  drop = TRUE,
  lex.order = TRUE
)


# ==============================================================
# 10. Distance-matrix subsetting/reordering helper
# ==============================================================

subset_distance_houseperm <- function(
  dist_object_houseperm,
  ids_houseperm
) {

  distance_matrix_houseperm <- as.matrix(
    dist_object_houseperm
  )


  stats::as.dist(
    distance_matrix_houseperm[
      ids_houseperm,
      ids_houseperm,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 11. Calculate the same three distance matrices
# ==============================================================

bray_raw_houseperm <- phyloseq::distance(
  ps_full_houseperm,
  method = "bray"
)


unweighted_raw_houseperm <- phyloseq::UniFrac(
  ps_full_houseperm,
  weighted = FALSE,
  normalized = TRUE,
  parallel = FALSE
)


weighted_raw_houseperm <- phyloseq::UniFrac(
  ps_full_houseperm,
  weighted = TRUE,
  normalized = TRUE,
  parallel = FALSE
)


# ==============================================================
# 12. Reorder distances to match metadata
# ==============================================================

bray_houseperm <- subset_distance_houseperm(
  bray_raw_houseperm,
  sample_ids_houseperm
)


unweighted_houseperm <- subset_distance_houseperm(
  unweighted_raw_houseperm,
  sample_ids_houseperm
)


weighted_houseperm <- subset_distance_houseperm(
  weighted_raw_houseperm,
  sample_ids_houseperm
)


distances_houseperm <- list(

  "Bray-Curtis" =
    bray_houseperm,

  "Unweighted UniFrac" =
    unweighted_houseperm,

  "Weighted UniFrac" =
    weighted_houseperm
)


# ==============================================================
# 13. Growout-specific metadata
# ==============================================================

meta_g1_houseperm <- droplevels(
  meta_houseperm[
    meta_houseperm$Growout == "1",
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)


meta_g2_houseperm <- droplevels(
  meta_houseperm[
    meta_houseperm$Growout == "2",
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)


ids_g1_houseperm <- rownames(
  meta_g1_houseperm
)


ids_g2_houseperm <- rownames(
  meta_g2_houseperm
)


# ==============================================================
# 14. WHOLE-HOUSE permutation design
#
# Used for:
#
#   - Collective Treatment
#   - Treatment x Growout
#
# Every House is treated as one whole plot.
# Houses move freely.
#
# Within(type = "none") means that the 10 observations within
# each House retain their structure and move together.
#
# With 6 Houses there are 6! = 720 House-order permutations,
# including the observed ordering.
# ==============================================================

perm_control_house_houseperm <- permute::how(

  nperm =
    nperm_houseperm,

  plots =
    permute::Plots(
      strata =
        meta_houseperm$House,
      type =
        "free"
    ),

  within =
    permute::Within(
      type =
        "none"
    ),

  complete =
    TRUE
)


set.seed(42)


perm_house_houseperm <- permute::shuffleSet(

  n =
    nrow(
      meta_houseperm
    ),

  nset =
    nperm_houseperm,

  control =
    perm_control_house_houseperm
)


# ==============================================================
# 15. WHOLE-HOUSE permutation design: Growout 1
#
# Each House contains five Positions.
# All five move together.
# ==============================================================

perm_control_house_g1_houseperm <- permute::how(

  nperm =
    nperm_houseperm,

  plots =
    permute::Plots(
      strata =
        meta_g1_houseperm$House,
      type =
        "free"
    ),

  within =
    permute::Within(
      type =
        "none"
    ),

  complete =
    TRUE
)


set.seed(42)


perm_house_g1_houseperm <- permute::shuffleSet(

  n =
    nrow(
      meta_g1_houseperm
    ),

  nset =
    nperm_houseperm,

  control =
    perm_control_house_g1_houseperm
)


# ==============================================================
# 16. WHOLE-HOUSE permutation design: Growout 2
# ==============================================================

perm_control_house_g2_houseperm <- permute::how(

  nperm =
    nperm_houseperm,

  plots =
    permute::Plots(
      strata =
        meta_g2_houseperm$House,
      type =
        "free"
    ),

  within =
    permute::Within(
      type =
        "none"
    ),

  complete =
    TRUE
)


set.seed(42)


perm_house_g2_houseperm <- permute::shuffleSet(

  n =
    nrow(
      meta_g2_houseperm
    ),

  nset =
    nperm_houseperm,

  control =
    perm_control_house_g2_houseperm
)


# ==============================================================
# 17. GROWOUT permutation design
#
# Growout is repeated within House.
#
# Each House contains two Growout blocks:
#
#   Growout 1 = A B C D E
#   Growout 2 = A B C D E
#
# The two Growout blocks may exchange within each House.
#
# The five defined Positions within each Growout block remain
# together and retain their internal structure.
# ==============================================================

perm_control_growout_houseperm <- permute::how(

  nperm =
    nperm_houseperm,

  blocks =
    meta_houseperm$House,

  plots =
    permute::Plots(
      strata =
        meta_houseperm$House_Growout_houseperm,
      type =
        "free"
    ),

  within =
    permute::Within(
      type =
        "none"
    ),

  complete =
    TRUE
)


set.seed(42)


perm_growout_houseperm <- permute::shuffleSet(

  n =
    nrow(
      meta_houseperm
    ),

  nset =
    nperm_houseperm,

  control =
    perm_control_growout_houseperm
)


# ==============================================================
# 18. POSITION permutation design
#
# A-E are defined physical locations followed across both
# Growouts.
#
# Therefore Position is NOT independently permuted within each
# House x Growout.
#
# Instead, each House x Position combination is treated as a
# repeated Position trajectory:
#
#   Position A:
#       Growout 1 A
#       Growout 2 A
#
#   Position B:
#       Growout 1 B
#       Growout 2 B
#
#   etc.
#
# The five Position trajectories may be permuted within each
# House, while the two Growout observations belonging to each
# Position remain linked.
# ==============================================================

perm_control_position_houseperm <- permute::how(

  nperm =
    nperm_houseperm,

  blocks =
    meta_houseperm$House,

  plots =
    permute::Plots(
      strata =
        meta_houseperm$House_Position_houseperm,
      type =
        "free"
    ),

  within =
    permute::Within(
      type =
        "none"
    ),

  complete =
    FALSE
)


set.seed(42)


perm_position_houseperm <- permute::shuffleSet(

  n =
    nrow(
      meta_houseperm
    ),

  nset =
    nperm_houseperm,

  control =
    perm_control_position_houseperm
)


# ==============================================================
# 19. Print permutation-design information
# ==============================================================

treatment_counts_houseperm <- table(
  house_treatment_map_houseperm$Treatment
)


n_houses_houseperm <- nrow(
  house_treatment_map_houseperm
)


if (
  length(
    treatment_counts_houseperm
  ) == 2 &&
  length(
    unique(
      as.numeric(
        treatment_counts_houseperm
      )
    )
  ) == 1
) {

  treatment_allocations_houseperm <- choose(
    n_houses_houseperm,
    as.numeric(
      treatment_counts_houseperm[1]
    )
  )


  minimum_treatment_p_houseperm <-
    2 /
    treatment_allocations_houseperm

} else {

  treatment_allocations_houseperm <-
    NA_real_


  minimum_treatment_p_houseperm <-
    NA_real_
}


cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "PERMUTATION CHECK\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  sep = ""
)


cat(
  "Whole-House permutations supplied:",
  nrow(
    perm_house_houseperm
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Growout-block permutations supplied:",
  nrow(
    perm_growout_houseperm
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Position-trajectory permutations supplied:",
  nrow(
    perm_position_houseperm
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Possible balanced Treatment allocations:",
  treatment_allocations_houseperm,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Minimum attainable label-symmetric Treatment p-value:",
  minimum_treatment_p_houseperm,
  "\n"
)


# ==============================================================
# 20. Helper to extract one adonis2 term
# ==============================================================

extract_adonis_houseperm <- function(
  fit_houseperm,
  effect_houseperm,
  metric_houseperm,
  analysis_houseperm,
  growout_houseperm,
  model_houseperm,
  permutation_houseperm
) {

  table_houseperm <- as.data.frame(
    fit_houseperm
  )


  table_houseperm$Effect_houseperm <- rownames(
    table_houseperm
  )


  row_houseperm <- table_houseperm[
    table_houseperm$Effect_houseperm ==
      effect_houseperm,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  # Allow either interaction ordering
  if (
    nrow(
      row_houseperm
    ) == 0 &&
    effect_houseperm ==
      "Treatment:Growout"
  ) {

    row_houseperm <- table_houseperm[
      table_houseperm$Effect_houseperm ==
        "Growout:Treatment",
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }


  if (
    nrow(
      row_houseperm
    ) != 1
  ) {

    cat(
      "\nAvailable adonis2 terms:\n"
    )


    print(
      table_houseperm$Effect_houseperm
    )


    stop(
      paste(
        "Could not uniquely extract",
        effect_houseperm,
        "for",
        metric_houseperm,
        analysis_houseperm
      )
    )
  }


  p_column_houseperm <- grep(
    "^Pr\\(>F\\)$",
    names(
      row_houseperm
    ),
    value = TRUE
  )


  if (
    length(
      p_column_houseperm
    ) != 1
  ) {

    stop(
      "Could not identify the adonis2 p-value column."
    )
  }


  data.frame(

    Metric =
      metric_houseperm,

    Analysis =
      analysis_houseperm,

    Growout =
      growout_houseperm,

    Effect =
      effect_houseperm,

    Model =
      model_houseperm,

    Permutation_design =
      permutation_houseperm,

    Df =
      row_houseperm$Df,

    SumOfSqs =
      row_houseperm$SumOfSqs,

    R2 =
      row_houseperm$R2,

    F =
      row_houseperm$F,

    P_value =
      as.numeric(
        row_houseperm[
          1,
          p_column_houseperm
        ]
      ),

    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 21. Storage for PERMANOVA
# ==============================================================

permanova_fits_houseperm <- list()

permanova_rows_houseperm <- list()


# ==============================================================
# 22. Run PERMANOVA for all three distance metrics
# ==============================================================

for (
  metric_name_houseperm in names(
    distances_houseperm
  )
) {

  cat(
    "\n\n============================================================\n",
    metric_name_houseperm,
    "\n============================================================\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  dist_metric_houseperm <- getElement(
    distances_houseperm,
    metric_name_houseperm
  )


  # ============================================================
  # A. COLLECTIVE TREATMENT
  #
  # Model:
  #   distance ~ Treatment + Growout + Position
  #
  # Treatment:
  #   whole-House permutations
  #
  # We extract ONLY Treatment from this fit.
  # The Growout and Position p-values produced under this
  # permutation scheme are not used.
  # ============================================================

  fit_treatment_houseperm <- vegan::adonis2(

    dist_metric_houseperm ~
      Treatment +
      Growout +
      Position,

    data =
      meta_houseperm,

    permutations =
      perm_house_houseperm,

    by =
      "margin"
  )


  permanova_fits_houseperm[
    paste(
      metric_name_houseperm,
      "Collective Treatment",
      sep = " | "
    )
  ] <- list(
    fit_treatment_houseperm
  )


  permanova_rows_houseperm[
    length(
      permanova_rows_houseperm
    ) + 1
  ] <- list(

    extract_adonis_houseperm(

      fit_houseperm =
        fit_treatment_houseperm,

      effect_houseperm =
        "Treatment",

      metric_houseperm =
        metric_name_houseperm,

      analysis_houseperm =
        "Collective Treatment",

      growout_houseperm =
        "1-2",

      model_houseperm =
        "Treatment + Growout + Position",

      permutation_houseperm =
        "Whole House"
    )
  )


  # ============================================================
  # B. COLLECTIVE GROWOUT
  #
  # Same additive PERMANOVA model.
  #
  # Growout:
  #   whole Growout blocks permuted within House.
  #
  # We extract ONLY Growout from this fit.
  # ============================================================

  fit_growout_houseperm <- vegan::adonis2(

    dist_metric_houseperm ~
      Treatment +
      Growout +
      Position,

    data =
      meta_houseperm,

    permutations =
      perm_growout_houseperm,

    by =
      "margin"
  )


  permanova_fits_houseperm[
    paste(
      metric_name_houseperm,
      "Collective Growout",
      sep = " | "
    )
  ] <- list(
    fit_growout_houseperm
  )


  permanova_rows_houseperm[
    length(
      permanova_rows_houseperm
    ) + 1
  ] <- list(

    extract_adonis_houseperm(

      fit_houseperm =
        fit_growout_houseperm,

      effect_houseperm =
        "Growout",

      metric_houseperm =
        metric_name_houseperm,

      analysis_houseperm =
        "Collective Growout",

      growout_houseperm =
        "1-2",

      model_houseperm =
        "Treatment + Growout + Position",

      permutation_houseperm =
        "Growout blocks within House"
    )
  )


  # ============================================================
  # C. COLLECTIVE POSITION
  #
  # Same additive PERMANOVA model.
  #
  # Position:
  #   Position trajectories permuted within House.
  #
  # The same Position in Growout 1 and Growout 2 remains linked.
  #
  # We extract ONLY Position from this fit.
  # ============================================================

  fit_position_houseperm <- vegan::adonis2(

    dist_metric_houseperm ~
      Treatment +
      Growout +
      Position,

    data =
      meta_houseperm,

    permutations =
      perm_position_houseperm,

    by =
      "margin"
  )


  permanova_fits_houseperm[
    paste(
      metric_name_houseperm,
      "Collective Position",
      sep = " | "
    )
  ] <- list(
    fit_position_houseperm
  )


  permanova_rows_houseperm[
    length(
      permanova_rows_houseperm
    ) + 1
  ] <- list(

    extract_adonis_houseperm(

      fit_houseperm =
        fit_position_houseperm,

      effect_houseperm =
        "Position",

      metric_houseperm =
        metric_name_houseperm,

      analysis_houseperm =
        "Collective Position",

      growout_houseperm =
        "1-2",

      model_houseperm =
        "Treatment + Growout + Position",

      permutation_houseperm =
        "Position trajectories within House"
    )
  )


  # ============================================================
  # D. TREATMENT x GROWOUT INTERACTION
  #
  # Model:
  #   distance ~ Treatment * Growout + Position
  #
  # Whole Houses are permuted.
  #
  # This keeps both Growouts and all defined Positions belonging
  # to the same House together while changing their association
  # with House-level Treatment assignment.
  #
  # Only Treatment:Growout is extracted from this fit.
  # ============================================================

  fit_interaction_houseperm <- vegan::adonis2(

    dist_metric_houseperm ~
      Treatment * Growout +
      Position,

    data =
      meta_houseperm,

    permutations =
      perm_house_houseperm,

    by =
      "margin"
  )


  permanova_fits_houseperm[
    paste(
      metric_name_houseperm,
      "Treatment x Growout",
      sep = " | "
    )
  ] <- list(
    fit_interaction_houseperm
  )


  permanova_rows_houseperm[
    length(
      permanova_rows_houseperm
    ) + 1
  ] <- list(

    extract_adonis_houseperm(

      fit_houseperm =
        fit_interaction_houseperm,

      effect_houseperm =
        "Treatment:Growout",

      metric_houseperm =
        metric_name_houseperm,

      analysis_houseperm =
        "Treatment x Growout",

      growout_houseperm =
        "1-2",

      model_houseperm =
        "Treatment * Growout + Position",

      permutation_houseperm =
        "Whole House"
    )
  )


  # ============================================================
  # E. GROWOUT 1 TREATMENT
  #
  # Model:
  #   distance ~ Treatment + Position
  #
  # Treatment:
  #   whole-House permutations
  # ============================================================

  dist_g1_houseperm <- subset_distance_houseperm(
    dist_metric_houseperm,
    ids_g1_houseperm
  )


  fit_treatment_g1_houseperm <- vegan::adonis2(

    dist_g1_houseperm ~
      Treatment +
      Position,

    data =
      meta_g1_houseperm,

    permutations =
      perm_house_g1_houseperm,

    by =
      "margin"
  )


  permanova_fits_houseperm[
    paste(
      metric_name_houseperm,
      "Growout 1 Treatment",
      sep = " | "
    )
  ] <- list(
    fit_treatment_g1_houseperm
  )


  permanova_rows_houseperm[
    length(
      permanova_rows_houseperm
    ) + 1
  ] <- list(

    extract_adonis_houseperm(

      fit_houseperm =
        fit_treatment_g1_houseperm,

      effect_houseperm =
        "Treatment",

      metric_houseperm =
        metric_name_houseperm,

      analysis_houseperm =
        "Within Growout Treatment",

      growout_houseperm =
        "1",

      model_houseperm =
        "Treatment + Position",

      permutation_houseperm =
        "Whole House"
    )
  )


  # ============================================================
  # F. GROWOUT 2 TREATMENT
  #
  # Model:
  #   distance ~ Treatment + Position
  #
  # Treatment:
  #   whole-House permutations
  # ============================================================

  dist_g2_houseperm <- subset_distance_houseperm(
    dist_metric_houseperm,
    ids_g2_houseperm
  )


  fit_treatment_g2_houseperm <- vegan::adonis2(

    dist_g2_houseperm ~
      Treatment +
      Position,

    data =
      meta_g2_houseperm,

    permutations =
      perm_house_g2_houseperm,

    by =
      "margin"
  )


  permanova_fits_houseperm[
    paste(
      metric_name_houseperm,
      "Growout 2 Treatment",
      sep = " | "
    )
  ] <- list(
    fit_treatment_g2_houseperm
  )


  permanova_rows_houseperm[
    length(
      permanova_rows_houseperm
    ) + 1
  ] <- list(

    extract_adonis_houseperm(

      fit_houseperm =
        fit_treatment_g2_houseperm,

      effect_houseperm =
        "Treatment",

      metric_houseperm =
        metric_name_houseperm,

      analysis_houseperm =
        "Within Growout Treatment",

      growout_houseperm =
        "2",

      model_houseperm =
        "Treatment + Position",

      permutation_houseperm =
        "Whole House"
    )
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 23. Combined PERMANOVA summary
# ==============================================================

permanova_results_houseperm <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  permanova_rows_houseperm
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Metric,
    Analysis,
    Growout
  )


cat(
  "\n\n============================================================\n",
  "HOUSE-AWARE PERMANOVA RESULTS\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  sep = ""
)


print(
  permanova_results_houseperm,
  n = Inf
)


# ==============================================================
# 24. Beta-dispersion helper
#
# Same general method as original:
#
#   betadisper()
#   permutest()
#
# The permutation matrix follows the same experimental hierarchy
# used for the corresponding factor.
#
# type = "median" is stated explicitly for reproducibility.
# ==============================================================

run_dispersion_houseperm <- function(
  dist_houseperm,
  group_houseperm,
  permutations_houseperm,
  metric_houseperm,
  analysis_houseperm,
  growout_houseperm,
  effect_houseperm,
  permutation_design_houseperm
) {

  dispersion_object_houseperm <- vegan::betadisper(

    dist_houseperm,

    group =
      group_houseperm,

    type =
      "median"
  )


  dispersion_anova_houseperm <- stats::anova(
    dispersion_object_houseperm
  )


  dispersion_perm_houseperm <- vegan::permutest(

    dispersion_object_houseperm,

    permutations =
      permutations_houseperm,

    pairwise =
      TRUE
  )


  dispersion_table_houseperm <- as.data.frame(
    dispersion_perm_houseperm$tab
  )


  dispersion_p_column_houseperm <- grep(
    "^Pr\\(>F\\)$",
    names(
      dispersion_table_houseperm
    ),
    value = TRUE
  )


  if (
    length(
      dispersion_p_column_houseperm
    ) != 1
  ) {

    stop(
      "Could not identify beta-dispersion permutation p-value."
    )
  }


  dispersion_summary_houseperm <- data.frame(

    Metric =
      metric_houseperm,

    Analysis =
      analysis_houseperm,

    Growout =
      growout_houseperm,

    Effect =
      effect_houseperm,

    Permutation_design =
      permutation_design_houseperm,

    F =
      dispersion_table_houseperm$F[1],

    ANOVA_P =
      dispersion_anova_houseperm$`Pr(>F)`[1],

    Permutation_P =
      as.numeric(
        dispersion_table_houseperm[
          1,
          dispersion_p_column_houseperm
        ]
      ),

    N_permutations =
      nrow(
        permutations_houseperm
      ),

    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE
  )


  dispersion_means_houseperm <- data.frame(

    Group =
      as.character(
        dispersion_object_houseperm$group
      ),

    Distance_to_median =
      dispersion_object_houseperm$distances,

    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE
  ) %>%

    dplyr::group_by(
      Group
    ) %>%

    dplyr::summarise(

      N =
        dplyr::n(),

      Mean_distance =
        mean(
          Distance_to_median,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      SD_distance =
        stats::sd(
          Distance_to_median,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      .groups =
        "drop"
    ) %>%

    dplyr::mutate(

      Metric =
        metric_houseperm,

      Analysis =
        analysis_houseperm,

      Growout =
        growout_houseperm,

      Effect =
        effect_houseperm
    )


  list(

    summary =
      dispersion_summary_houseperm,

    means =
      dispersion_means_houseperm,

    object =
      dispersion_object_houseperm,

    permutation =
      dispersion_perm_houseperm
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 25. Storage for beta-dispersion results
# ==============================================================

dispersion_objects_houseperm <- list()

dispersion_rows_houseperm <- list()

dispersion_means_rows_houseperm <- list()


# ==============================================================
# 26. Run beta-dispersion analyses
#
# We evaluate:
#
#   1. Treatment collectively
#   2. Growout collectively
#   3. Position collectively
#   4. Treatment within Growout 1
#   5. Treatment within Growout 2
#
# We do NOT use a four-level Treatment x Growout dispersion test.
# A four-level grouping variable combines factors operating at
# different experimental levels and is not a direct test of the
# PERMANOVA interaction.
# ==============================================================

for (
  metric_name_houseperm in names(
    distances_houseperm
  )
) {

  dist_metric_houseperm <- getElement(
    distances_houseperm,
    metric_name_houseperm
  )


  # ============================================================
  # A. Collective Treatment dispersion
  #
  # Whole-House permutations
  # ============================================================

  disp_treatment_houseperm <- run_dispersion_houseperm(

    dist_houseperm =
      dist_metric_houseperm,

    group_houseperm =
      meta_houseperm$Treatment,

    permutations_houseperm =
      perm_house_houseperm,

    metric_houseperm =
      metric_name_houseperm,

    analysis_houseperm =
      "Collective Treatment",

    growout_houseperm =
      "1-2",

    effect_houseperm =
      "Treatment",

    permutation_design_houseperm =
      "Whole House"
  )


  dispersion_objects_houseperm[
    paste(
      metric_name_houseperm,
      "Collective Treatment",
      sep = " | "
    )
  ] <- list(
    disp_treatment_houseperm
  )


  dispersion_rows_houseperm[
    length(
      dispersion_rows_houseperm
    ) + 1
  ] <- list(
    getElement(
      disp_treatment_houseperm,
      "summary"
    )
  )


  dispersion_means_rows_houseperm[
    length(
      dispersion_means_rows_houseperm
    ) + 1
  ] <- list(
    getElement(
      disp_treatment_houseperm,
      "means"
    )
  )


  # ============================================================
  # B. Collective Growout dispersion
  #
  # Growout blocks permuted within House
  # ============================================================

  disp_growout_houseperm <- run_dispersion_houseperm(

    dist_houseperm =
      dist_metric_houseperm,

    group_houseperm =
      meta_houseperm$Growout,

    permutations_houseperm =
      perm_growout_houseperm,

    metric_houseperm =
      metric_name_houseperm,

    analysis_houseperm =
      "Collective Growout",

    growout_houseperm =
      "1-2",

    effect_houseperm =
      "Growout",

    permutation_design_houseperm =
      "Growout blocks within House"
  )


  dispersion_objects_houseperm[
    paste(
      metric_name_houseperm,
      "Collective Growout",
      sep = " | "
    )
  ] <- list(
    disp_growout_houseperm
  )


  dispersion_rows_houseperm[
    length(
      dispersion_rows_houseperm
    ) + 1
  ] <- list(
    getElement(
      disp_growout_houseperm,
      "summary"
    )
  )


  dispersion_means_rows_houseperm[
    length(
      dispersion_means_rows_houseperm
    ) + 1
  ] <- list(
    getElement(
      disp_growout_houseperm,
      "means"
    )
  )


  # ============================================================
  # C. Collective Position dispersion
  #
  # Position trajectories are permuted within House.
  #
  # The same physical Position in Growout 1 and Growout 2
  # remains linked.
  # ============================================================

  disp_position_houseperm <- run_dispersion_houseperm(

    dist_houseperm =
      dist_metric_houseperm,

    group_houseperm =
      meta_houseperm$Position,

    permutations_houseperm =
      perm_position_houseperm,

    metric_houseperm =
      metric_name_houseperm,

    analysis_houseperm =
      "Collective Position",

    growout_houseperm =
      "1-2",

    effect_houseperm =
      "Position",

    permutation_design_houseperm =
      "Position trajectories within House"
  )


  dispersion_objects_houseperm[
    paste(
      metric_name_houseperm,
      "Collective Position",
      sep = " | "
    )
  ] <- list(
    disp_position_houseperm
  )


  dispersion_rows_houseperm[
    length(
      dispersion_rows_houseperm
    ) + 1
  ] <- list(
    getElement(
      disp_position_houseperm,
      "summary"
    )
  )


  dispersion_means_rows_houseperm[
    length(
      dispersion_means_rows_houseperm
    ) + 1
  ] <- list(
    getElement(
      disp_position_houseperm,
      "means"
    )
  )


  # ============================================================
  # D. Growout 1 Treatment dispersion
  #
  # Whole-House permutations
  # ============================================================

  dist_g1_houseperm <- subset_distance_houseperm(
    dist_metric_houseperm,
    ids_g1_houseperm
  )


  disp_treatment_g1_houseperm <- run_dispersion_houseperm(

    dist_houseperm =
      dist_g1_houseperm,

    group_houseperm =
      meta_g1_houseperm$Treatment,

    permutations_houseperm =
      perm_house_g1_houseperm,

    metric_houseperm =
      metric_name_houseperm,

    analysis_houseperm =
      "Within Growout Treatment",

    growout_houseperm =
      "1",

    effect_houseperm =
      "Treatment",

    permutation_design_houseperm =
      "Whole House"
  )


  dispersion_objects_houseperm[
    paste(
      metric_name_houseperm,
      "Growout 1 Treatment",
      sep = " | "
    )
  ] <- list(
    disp_treatment_g1_houseperm
  )


  dispersion_rows_houseperm[
    length(
      dispersion_rows_houseperm
    ) + 1
  ] <- list(
    getElement(
      disp_treatment_g1_houseperm,
      "summary"
    )
  )


  dispersion_means_rows_houseperm[
    length(
      dispersion_means_rows_houseperm
    ) + 1
  ] <- list(
    getElement(
      disp_treatment_g1_houseperm,
      "means"
    )
  )


  # ============================================================
  # E. Growout 2 Treatment dispersion
  #
  # Whole-House permutations
  # ============================================================

  dist_g2_houseperm <- subset_distance_houseperm(
    dist_metric_houseperm,
    ids_g2_houseperm
  )


  disp_treatment_g2_houseperm <- run_dispersion_houseperm(

    dist_houseperm =
      dist_g2_houseperm,

    group_houseperm =
      meta_g2_houseperm$Treatment,

    permutations_houseperm =
      perm_house_g2_houseperm,

    metric_houseperm =
      metric_name_houseperm,

    analysis_houseperm =
      "Within Growout Treatment",

    growout_houseperm =
      "2",

    effect_houseperm =
      "Treatment",

    permutation_design_houseperm =
      "Whole House"
  )


  dispersion_objects_houseperm[
    paste(
      metric_name_houseperm,
      "Growout 2 Treatment",
      sep = " | "
    )
  ] <- list(
    disp_treatment_g2_houseperm
  )


  dispersion_rows_houseperm[
    length(
      dispersion_rows_houseperm
    ) + 1
  ] <- list(
    getElement(
      disp_treatment_g2_houseperm,
      "summary"
    )
  )


  dispersion_means_rows_houseperm[
    length(
      dispersion_means_rows_houseperm
    ) + 1
  ] <- list(
    getElement(
      disp_treatment_g2_houseperm,
      "means"
    )
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 27. Combined beta-dispersion summary
# ==============================================================

dispersion_results_houseperm <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dispersion_rows_houseperm
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Metric,
    Analysis,
    Growout
  )


dispersion_means_houseperm <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dispersion_means_rows_houseperm
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Metric,
    Analysis,
    Growout,
    Group
  )


cat(
  "\n\n============================================================\n",
  "HOUSE-AWARE BETA-DISPERSION RESULTS\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  sep = ""
)


print(
  dispersion_results_houseperm,
  n = Inf
)


cat(
  "\n\n============================================================\n",
  "MEAN DISTANCE TO GROUP MEDIAN\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  sep = ""
)


print(
  dispersion_means_houseperm,
  n = Inf
)


# ==============================================================
# 28. Final combined object
# ==============================================================

beta_stats_houseperm <- list(

  metadata =
    meta_houseperm,

  design =
    design_table_houseperm,

  distances =
    distances_houseperm,

  permutation_controls =
    list(

      House_collective =
        perm_control_house_houseperm,

      House_growout1 =
        perm_control_house_g1_houseperm,

      House_growout2 =
        perm_control_house_g2_houseperm,

      Growout =
        perm_control_growout_houseperm,

      Position =
        perm_control_position_houseperm
    ),

  permutation_matrices =
    list(

      House_collective =
        perm_house_houseperm,

      House_growout1 =
        perm_house_g1_houseperm,

      House_growout2 =
        perm_house_g2_houseperm,

      Growout =
        perm_growout_houseperm,

      Position =
        perm_position_houseperm
    ),

  permanova_fits =
    permanova_fits_houseperm,

  permanova_results =
    permanova_results_houseperm,

  dispersion_objects =
    dispersion_objects_houseperm,

  dispersion_results =
    dispersion_results_houseperm,

  dispersion_means =
    dispersion_means_houseperm
)


cat(
  "\n\n============================================================\n",
  "HOUSE-AWARE BETA-DIVERSITY ANALYSIS COMPLETE\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# UPDATED BETA-DIVERSITY HEATMAP
#
# Adds properly restricted growout-specific Position tests.
#
# Permutation structure:
#
# Collective:
#   Treatment            = whole House permutations
#   Growout              = Growout blocks within House
#   Position             = Position within House, with the same
#                          physical Position retained across Growouts
#   Treatment:Growout    = whole House permutations
#
# Growout-specific:
#   Treatment            = whole House permutations
#   Position             = Position permutations within House
#
# Uses the existing revised _houseperm PERMANOVA results.
#
# Does NOT overwrite existing analysis or heatmap objects.
# ==============================================================


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(vegan)
library(permute)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)


# ==============================================================
# 1. Confirm required revised-analysis objects are available
# ==============================================================

stopifnot(
  exists("nperm_houseperm"),
  exists("distances_houseperm"),
  exists("meta_g1_houseperm"),
  exists("meta_g2_houseperm"),
  exists("permanova_results_houseperm")
)


# ==============================================================
# 2. Confirm metadata ordering
# ==============================================================

stopifnot(
  !is.null(rownames(meta_g1_houseperm)),
  !is.null(rownames(meta_g2_houseperm)),
  all(c("Treatment", "House", "Position") %in% names(meta_g1_houseperm)),
  all(c("Treatment", "House", "Position") %in% names(meta_g2_houseperm))
)


# ==============================================================
# 3. Create growout-specific Position permutation matrices
#
# Within a single growout, each House contains the five defined
# Positions A-E once. Position is therefore permuted freely
# within House.
# ==============================================================

perm_control_position_g1_houseperm <- permute::how(
  nperm = nperm_houseperm,
  blocks = meta_g1_houseperm$House,
  within = permute::Within(
    type = "free"
  ),
  complete = FALSE
)


perm_position_g1_houseperm <- permute::shuffleSet(
  n = nrow(meta_g1_houseperm),
  nset = nperm_houseperm,
  control = perm_control_position_g1_houseperm
)


perm_control_position_g2_houseperm <- permute::how(
  nperm = nperm_houseperm,
  blocks = meta_g2_houseperm$House,
  within = permute::Within(
    type = "free"
  ),
  complete = FALSE
)


perm_position_g2_houseperm <- permute::shuffleSet(
  n = nrow(meta_g2_houseperm),
  nset = nperm_houseperm,
  control = perm_control_position_g2_houseperm
)


# ==============================================================
# 4. Helper to subset a distance matrix to one growout
# ==============================================================

subset_distance_houseperm <- function(
  distance_object_houseperm,
  metadata_houseperm
) {

  distance_matrix_houseperm <- as.matrix(
    distance_object_houseperm
  )

  sample_ids_houseperm <- rownames(
    metadata_houseperm
  )


  if (
    !all(
      sample_ids_houseperm %in%
        rownames(distance_matrix_houseperm)
    )
  ) {

    stop(
      "Not all metadata samples were found in the distance matrix."
    )
  }


  as.dist(
    distance_matrix_houseperm[
      sample_ids_houseperm,
      sample_ids_houseperm,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 5. Helper to run growout-specific Position PERMANOVA
#
# Formula:
#   distance ~ Treatment + Position
#
# Only the Position row is retained because this permutation
# design is appropriate for Position inference.
# ==============================================================

run_position_growout_houseperm <- function(
  distance_object_houseperm,
  metadata_houseperm,
  permutation_matrix_houseperm,
  metric_houseperm,
  growout_houseperm
) {

  distance_growout_houseperm <- subset_distance_houseperm(
    distance_object_houseperm,
    metadata_houseperm
  )


  fit_position_growout_houseperm <- vegan::adonis2(
    distance_growout_houseperm ~ Treatment + Position,
    data = metadata_houseperm,
    permutations = permutation_matrix_houseperm,
    by = "margin"
  )


  fit_table_houseperm <- as.data.frame(
    fit_position_growout_houseperm
  )


  if (
    !"Position" %in% rownames(fit_table_houseperm)
  ) {

    stop(
      paste(
        "Position row not found for",
        metric_houseperm,
        "Growout",
        growout_houseperm
      )
    )
  }


  data.frame(
    Metric = metric_houseperm,
    Analysis = paste0(
      "Within G",
      growout_houseperm,
      " Position"
    ),
    Growout = as.character(
      growout_houseperm
    ),
    Effect = "Position",
    R2 = fit_table_houseperm[
      "Position",
      "R2"
    ],
    F = fit_table_houseperm[
      "Position",
      "F"
    ],
    P_value = fit_table_houseperm[
      "Position",
      "Pr(>F)"
    ],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 6. Run Position tests for Growout 1
# ==============================================================

position_results_g1_houseperm <- dplyr::bind_rows(

  run_position_growout_houseperm(
    distance_object_houseperm = getElement(
      distances_houseperm,
      "Bray-Curtis"
    ),
    metadata_houseperm = meta_g1_houseperm,
    permutation_matrix_houseperm = perm_position_g1_houseperm,
    metric_houseperm = "Bray-Curtis",
    growout_houseperm = "1"
  ),

  run_position_growout_houseperm(
    distance_object_houseperm = getElement(
      distances_houseperm,
      "Unweighted UniFrac"
    ),
    metadata_houseperm = meta_g1_houseperm,
    permutation_matrix_houseperm = perm_position_g1_houseperm,
    metric_houseperm = "Unweighted UniFrac",
    growout_houseperm = "1"
  ),

  run_position_growout_houseperm(
    distance_object_houseperm = getElement(
      distances_houseperm,
      "Weighted UniFrac"
    ),
    metadata_houseperm = meta_g1_houseperm,
    permutation_matrix_houseperm = perm_position_g1_houseperm,
    metric_houseperm = "Weighted UniFrac",
    growout_houseperm = "1"
  )
)


# ==============================================================
# 7. Run Position tests for Growout 2
# ==============================================================

position_results_g2_houseperm <- dplyr::bind_rows(

  run_position_growout_houseperm(
    distance_object_houseperm = getElement(
      distances_houseperm,
      "Bray-Curtis"
    ),
    metadata_houseperm = meta_g2_houseperm,
    permutation_matrix_houseperm = perm_position_g2_houseperm,
    metric_houseperm = "Bray-Curtis",
    growout_houseperm = "2"
  ),

  run_position_growout_houseperm(
    distance_object_houseperm = getElement(
      distances_houseperm,
      "Unweighted UniFrac"
    ),
    metadata_houseperm = meta_g2_houseperm,
    permutation_matrix_houseperm = perm_position_g2_houseperm,
    metric_houseperm = "Unweighted UniFrac",
    growout_houseperm = "2"
  ),

  run_position_growout_houseperm(
    distance_object_houseperm = getElement(
      distances_houseperm,
      "Weighted UniFrac"
    ),
    metadata_houseperm = meta_g2_houseperm,
    permutation_matrix_houseperm = perm_position_g2_houseperm,
    metric_houseperm = "Weighted UniFrac",
    growout_houseperm = "2"
  )
)


# ==============================================================
# 8. Combine new growout-specific Position results
# ==============================================================

position_results_growout_houseperm <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  position_results_g1_houseperm,
  position_results_g2_houseperm
)


cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "GROWOUT-SPECIFIC POSITION PERMANOVA RESULTS\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  sep = ""
)


print(
  position_results_growout_houseperm
)


# ==============================================================
# 9. Add these results to the existing revised PERMANOVA summary
#
# This creates a NEW object and does not modify
# permanova_results_houseperm.
# ==============================================================

permanova_results_heatmap_houseperm <- dplyr::bind_rows(

  permanova_results_houseperm,

  position_results_growout_houseperm
)


# ==============================================================
# 10. Standardize effect names and heatmap row labels
# ==============================================================

permanova_heatmap_data_houseperm <-
  permanova_results_heatmap_houseperm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Effect_heatmap_houseperm =
      dplyr::case_when(

        Effect == "Treatment" ~
          "Treatment",

        Effect == "Growout" ~
          "Growout",

        Effect == "Position" ~
          "Position",

        Effect %in% c(
          "Treatment:Growout",
          "Growout:Treatment",
          "Treatment x Growout"
        ) ~
          "Treatment:Growout",

        TRUE ~
          as.character(
            Effect
          )
      ),

    Growout_heatmap_houseperm =
      dplyr::case_when(

        grepl(
          "Collective",
          Analysis,
          ignore.case = TRUE
        ) ~
          "Collective",

        grepl(
          "Treatment x Growout",
          Analysis,
          ignore.case = TRUE
        ) ~
          "Collective",

        grepl(
          "G1",
          Analysis,
          ignore.case = TRUE
        ) ~
          "1",

        grepl(
          "Growout 1",
          Analysis,
          ignore.case = TRUE
        ) ~
          "1",

        grepl(
          "G2",
          Analysis,
          ignore.case = TRUE
        ) ~
          "2",

        grepl(
          "Growout 2",
          Analysis,
          ignore.case = TRUE
        ) ~
          "2",

        as.character(Growout) %in%
          c(
            "1",
            "2",
            "Collective"
          ) ~
          as.character(
            Growout
          ),

        TRUE ~
          NA_character_
      ),

    Col_houseperm =
      paste(
        Growout_heatmap_houseperm,
        Metric,
        sep = " | "
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(
      Growout_heatmap_houseperm
    ),
    Effect_heatmap_houseperm %in%
      c(
        "Treatment",
        "Growout",
        "Position",
        "Treatment:Growout"
      )
  )


# ==============================================================
# 11. Define heatmap ordering
# ==============================================================

term_order_houseperm <- c(
  "Treatment",
  "Growout",
  "Position",
  "Treatment:Growout"
)


row_order_houseperm <- c(

  "Collective | Bray-Curtis",
  "Collective | Unweighted UniFrac",
  "Collective | Weighted UniFrac",

  "1 | Bray-Curtis",
  "1 | Unweighted UniFrac",
  "1 | Weighted UniFrac",

  "2 | Bray-Curtis",
  "2 | Unweighted UniFrac",
  "2 | Weighted UniFrac"
)


# ==============================================================
# 12. Build R2 matrix
# ==============================================================

r2_df_heatmap_houseperm <-
  permanova_heatmap_data_houseperm %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Effect_heatmap_houseperm,
    Col_houseperm,
    R2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Effect_heatmap_houseperm =
      term_order_houseperm,
    Col_houseperm =
      row_order_houseperm
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from =
      Col_houseperm,
    values_from =
      R2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Effect_heatmap_houseperm =
      factor(
        Effect_heatmap_houseperm,
        levels =
          term_order_houseperm
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Effect_heatmap_houseperm
  )


rnames_r2_heatmap_houseperm <- as.character(
  r2_df_heatmap_houseperm$Effect_heatmap_houseperm
)


r2_mat_heatmap_houseperm <- as.matrix(
  r2_df_heatmap_houseperm[
    ,
    row_order_houseperm,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)


rownames(
  r2_mat_heatmap_houseperm
) <- rnames_r2_heatmap_houseperm


# ==============================================================
# 13. Build p-value matrix
# ==============================================================

p_df_heatmap_houseperm <-
  permanova_heatmap_data_houseperm %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Effect_heatmap_houseperm,
    Col_houseperm,
    P_value
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Effect_heatmap_houseperm =
      term_order_houseperm,
    Col_houseperm =
      row_order_houseperm
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from =
      Col_houseperm,
    values_from =
      P_value
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Effect_heatmap_houseperm =
      factor(
        Effect_heatmap_houseperm,
        levels =
          term_order_houseperm
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Effect_heatmap_houseperm
  )


rnames_p_heatmap_houseperm <- as.character(
  p_df_heatmap_houseperm$Effect_heatmap_houseperm
)


p_mat_heatmap_houseperm <- as.matrix(
  p_df_heatmap_houseperm[
    ,
    row_order_houseperm,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)


rownames(
  p_mat_heatmap_houseperm
) <- rnames_p_heatmap_houseperm


# ==============================================================
# 14. Confirm matrices align
# ==============================================================

stopifnot(
  identical(
    rownames(
      r2_mat_heatmap_houseperm
    ),
    rownames(
      p_mat_heatmap_houseperm
    )
  ),
  identical(
    colnames(
      r2_mat_heatmap_houseperm
    ),
    colnames(
      p_mat_heatmap_houseperm
    )
  )
)


# ==============================================================
# 15. Print values used in the heatmap
# ==============================================================

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "HEATMAP R2 MATRIX\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  sep = ""
)


print(
  round(
    r2_mat_heatmap_houseperm,
    4
  )
)


cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "HEATMAP P-VALUE MATRIX\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  sep = ""
)


print(
  p_mat_heatmap_houseperm
)


# ==============================================================
# 16. Transpose
#
# Rows:
#   Growout | Metric
#
# Columns:
#   Treatment
#   Growout
#   Position
#   Treatment:Growout
# ==============================================================

r2_t_heatmap_houseperm <- t(
  r2_mat_heatmap_houseperm
)


p_t_heatmap_houseperm <- t(
  p_mat_heatmap_houseperm
)


# ==============================================================
# 17. Row annotations
# ==============================================================

parse_row_heatmap_houseperm <- function(
  lbl_houseperm
) {

  parts_houseperm <- getElement(
    strsplit(
      lbl_houseperm,
      "\\s*\\|\\s*"
    ),
    1
  )


  if (
    length(
      parts_houseperm
    ) != 2
  ) {

    parts_houseperm <- c(
      lbl_houseperm,
      ""
    )
  }


  data.frame(

    Growout =
      parts_houseperm[1],

    Metric =
      parts_houseperm[2],

    row.names =
      lbl_houseperm,

    check.rows =
      FALSE
  )
}


row_meta_heatmap_houseperm <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    rownames(
      r2_t_heatmap_houseperm
    ),
    parse_row_heatmap_houseperm
  )
)


# ==============================================================
# 18. Annotation colors
#
# Same aesthetics as the existing heatmap.
# ==============================================================

anno_cols_heatmap_houseperm <- list(

  Growout = c(
    "1" = "#dbe9ff",
    "2" = "#ffe8d5",
    "Collective" = "#000004"
  ),

  Metric = c(
    "Bray-Curtis" = "#fcffa4",
    "Unweighted UniFrac" = "#bc3754",
    "Weighted UniFrac" = "#440154"
  )
)


row_anno_heatmap_houseperm <-
  ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(

    df =
      row_meta_heatmap_houseperm,

    col =
      anno_cols_heatmap_houseperm,

    show_annotation_name =
      FALSE,

    annotation_legend_param =
      list(
        border = TRUE
      ),

    gp =
      grid::gpar(
        col = "black"
      ),

    simple_anno_size =
      grid::unit(
        0.25,
        "cm"
      )
  )


# ==============================================================
# 19. R2 color scale
#
# Same cornsilk -> pink4 palette.
# ==============================================================

r2_max_obs_heatmap_houseperm <- suppressWarnings(
  max(
    r2_t_heatmap_houseperm,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)


r2_upper_heatmap_houseperm <- min(
  0.5,
  ifelse(
    is.finite(
      r2_max_obs_heatmap_houseperm
    ),
    max(
      0.3,
      r2_max_obs_heatmap_houseperm
    ),
    0.5
  )
)


pal_r2_heatmap_houseperm <- circlize::colorRamp2(

  c(
    0,
    r2_upper_heatmap_houseperm
  ),

  c(
    "cornsilk",
    "pink4"
  )
)


# ==============================================================
# 20. Significance asterisks
# ==============================================================

stars_heatmap_houseperm <- matrix(

  "",

  nrow =
    nrow(
      p_t_heatmap_houseperm
    ),

  ncol =
    ncol(
      p_t_heatmap_houseperm
    ),

  dimnames =
    dimnames(
      p_t_heatmap_houseperm
    )
)


stars_heatmap_houseperm[
  p_t_heatmap_houseperm < 0.05 &
    !is.na(
      p_t_heatmap_houseperm
    )
] <- "*"


stars_heatmap_houseperm[
  p_t_heatmap_houseperm < 0.01 &
    !is.na(
      p_t_heatmap_houseperm
    )
] <- "**"


stars_heatmap_houseperm[
  p_t_heatmap_houseperm < 0.001 &
    !is.na(
      p_t_heatmap_houseperm
    )
] <- "***"


# ==============================================================
# 21. R2 legend
# ==============================================================

legend_breaks_heatmap_houseperm <- seq(
  0,
  r2_upper_heatmap_houseperm,
  length.out = 6
)


lgd_r2_heatmap_houseperm <- list(

  title =
    expression(
      R^2
    ),

  title_gp =
    grid::gpar(
      fontsize = 12,
      fontface = "bold"
    ),

  labels_gp =
    grid::gpar(
      fontsize = 10
    ),

  border =
    "black",

  lwd =
    0.5,

  direction =
    "vertical",

  title_position =
    "topcenter",

  at =
    legend_breaks_heatmap_houseperm,

  labels =
    format(
      legend_breaks_heatmap_houseperm,
      digits = 2
    ),

  legend_width =
    grid::unit(
      3,
      "cm"
    ),

  legend_height =
    grid::unit(
      3,
      "cm"
    ),

  x =
    grid::unit(
      0.5,
      "cm"
    ),

  y =
    grid::unit(
      0.5,
      "cm"
    ),

  legend_gp =
    grid::gpar(
      col = "black",
      lwd = 1
    )
)


# ==============================================================
# 22. Heatmap
# ==============================================================

ht_r2_heatmap_houseperm <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(

  r2_t_heatmap_houseperm,

  name =
    "R2",

  col =
    pal_r2_heatmap_houseperm,

  na_col =
    "gray",

  left_annotation =
    row_anno_heatmap_houseperm,

  cluster_rows =
    TRUE,

  cluster_columns =
    TRUE,

  show_row_names =
    FALSE,

  show_column_names =
    TRUE,

  column_names_gp =
    grid::gpar(
      fontsize = 9,
      col = "black"
    ),

  column_names_rot =
    45,

  rect_gp =
    grid::gpar(
      col = "black",
      lwd = 2
    ),

  border_gp =
    grid::gpar(
      col = "black",
      lwd = 2
    ),

  heatmap_legend_param =
    lgd_r2_heatmap_houseperm,

  cell_fun = function(
    j,
    i,
    x,
    y,
    width,
    height,
    fill
  ) {

    lab_houseperm <- stars_heatmap_houseperm[
      i,
      j
    ]


    if (
      !is.na(
        lab_houseperm
      ) &&
      nzchar(
        lab_houseperm
      )
    ) {

      grid::grid.text(

        lab_houseperm,

        x =
          x,

        y =
          y,

        gp =
          grid::gpar(
            col = "black",
            fontsize = 16,
            fontface = "bold"
          )
      )
    }
  }
)


# ==============================================================
# 23. Export
# ==============================================================

png(

  "beta.heat.2.houseperm.with_position.png",

  width =
    3.80,

  height =
    5,

  units =
    "in",

  res =
    900,

  bg =
    "transparent"
)


ComplexHeatmap::draw(

  ht_r2_heatmap_houseperm,

  heatmap_legend_side =
    "right",

  annotation_legend_side =
    "right",

  padding =
    grid::unit(
      c(
        5,
        5,
        5,
        5
      ),
      "mm"
    )
)


dev.off()

```
